Author: Amletick
Name: Emote Mirror
Description: When a (Lightless-synced) player uses an emote on you, Emote Mirror copies their modded animation, VFX and sounds onto you as a temporary Penumbra mod and replies with the same emote. Friend-only / party-only filters and a nickname blacklist. Appearance try-on moved to the separate Look Mirror plugin.
Punchline: Copies the dance/emote mod of whoever emotes at you.
